note: REQUIREMENTS_DOCUMENTED: P3/P4/P5 stage requirements extracted from vendor source (src/hokom/canonical/stages/p2_p5.py) and documented. All four E3 gates require owner to run full Hokom pipeline on Python 3.12+ to verify actual stage acceptance. Cannot be sandbox-verified without live Hokom NLP analysis (hokom_evidence_by_stage populated by caller). E4B proceeds in parallel.

P3_ROOT_STEM_CLOSURE.condition_for_opening: prior_output.accepted == True (P2 must ACCEPT before P3 runs)
P3_ROOT_STEM_CLOSURE.corpus_expectation: Most 2:282 ISM/FI3L tokens are tri- or quadriliteral roots (consonant_count >= 2) → ACCEPT expected for most tokens

P4_JAMID_MUSHTAQ.corpus_expectation: 2:282 has both jamid (حَقًّا, كِتَابٌ) and mushtaq (كَاتِبٌ, مَدِينَةٌ) tokens

decision_rules.BLOCK: word_type_conflict == True (geometry conflicts with declared word class)

P5_MUFRAD_WORD_CONTRACTS.corpus_expectation: Hokom NLP resolves word_geometry for known tokens from classical lexicons

pipeline_structure.note: CanonicalPipeline.build() in src/hokom/canonical/pipeline.py contains 19 adapters P0-P12. P3/P4/P5 are stages 3/4/5 of the 0-indexed sequence. Adapters run sequentially — each prior_output feeds the next stage.
pipeline_structure.p2_to_p3_handoff: P2_REGISTRY_PROJECTION.prior_output.accepted must be True for P3 to open. registry_matches=[] (non-None) deactivates the blocker but does not guarantee P2 acceptance — the full Hokom P2 stage logic must accept.
pipeline_structure.evidence_structure: WordInput.hokom_evidence_by_stage is a dict keyed by layer_id. Each stage reads its evidence via input.hokom_evidence.get(key, default).

gates.note_G_E3_01: P3_ROOT_STEM_CLOSURE accepts for at least one corpus token (consonant_count >= 2). Owner must run full Hokom pipeline on Python 3.12+ and verify P3 does not universally BLOCK.
gates.note_G_E3_02: P4_JAMID_MUSHTAQ accepts for at least one corpus token (jamid_mushtaq in ('jamid','mushtaq')). Owner must verify P4 is not universally DEFERRED with 'unknown' classification.
gates.note_G_E3_03: P5_MUFRAD_WORD_CONTRACTS accepts for at least one corpus token (word_type_conflict == False). Owner must verify P5 resolves word geometry for known tokens.
gates.note_G_E3_04: End-to-end: at least one corpus token flows P0→P2→P3→P4→P5 with all stages ACCEPT. This verifies the full continuity chain from E2 (registry wired) through E3 (P3/P4/P5 acceptance).

blocking_residuals.detail: Run full Hokom pipeline on Python 3.12+ with corpus tokens from AYAT_AL_DAYN_REGISTRY. Verify P3/P4/P5 stages do not universally block. Check consonant_count, jamid_mushtaq, word_geometry evidence keys are populated by Hokom NLP.

owner_verification_commands.description: Owner must run these on Python 3.12+ with full Hokom pipeline available
owner_verification_commands.step1_p3_check: Run pipeline on 'دَيْنٍ' (ISM, root دين, 3 consonants). Expect: P3 consonant_count=3 → ACCEPT
owner_verification_commands.step2_p4_check: Run pipeline on 'كَاتِبٌ' (ISM, mushtaq from كتب). Expect: P4 jamid_mushtaq='mushtaq' → ACCEPT
owner_verification_commands.step3_p5_check: Run pipeline on any resolved ISM. Expect: P5 word_type_conflict=False → ACCEPT
owner_verification_commands.step4_e2e_check: Verify at least one token flows P0→P5 with all ACCEPT verdicts

fiqhi_algebra.WAD: Stage evidence requirements extracted from vendor source (p2_p5.py line-by-line analysis)
fiqhi_algebra.SABAB: E3 = P3/P4/P5 continuity; E4 (licensing boundary) requires P3 ACCEPT as precondition
fiqhi_algebra.SHART: Python 3.12+ for full pipeline; hokom_evidence_by_stage populated by Hokom NLP
fiqhi_algebra.MANI: Sandbox cannot run Hokom NLP — evidence keys cannot be artificially injected for gate verification
fiqhi_algebra.ILLA: All three stages (P3/P4/P5) must ACCEPT for at least one corpus token
fiqhi_algebra.QADIH: Potential: if Hokom NLP produces consonant_count=0 for all tokens → P3 universally BLOCKS → E4 cannot proceed
fiqhi_algebra.HUKM: REQUIREMENTS_DOCUMENTED — stage logic understood; owner verification required for gate confirmation
fiqhi_algebra.ATHAR: E4A/E4B/E4C can proceed in parallel (E4B does not require P3 ACCEPT, only WeightReadinessCandidate construction)

parallel_progression_note: E4B (PRE-WEIGHT TYPED CARRIERS) proceeds in parallel per constitutional §5. E4B does not require P3 ACCEPT — it operates on WeightReadinessCandidate constructed directly from token surface, independent of the Hokom pipeline stage state.
note_canonical_exit: canonical_exit=0 — all 4 gates pending owner verification. E4B proceeds in parallel.
